sourceRecords.title: 18 · Glasstaff’s quarters · area 12
read: A better-appointed room sits beyond the rougher hideout. Papers lie beside a travel chest. Someone has been planning from here.

The desk and chest suggest different sorts of business: work done in the open and possessions kept close. You can examine what is visible, listen toward the adjoining spaces, or check the way you came. Nothing here tells you what happened after someone left without further evidence.

brief: Small comfortably appointed stone bedchamber. Scarlet cloth drapes cover walls. A modest writing desk with matching chair, comfortable bed and closed wooden chest at its foot. Lamp light; ordinary unreadable papers can lie on desk. CURRENT campaign: Glasstaff has escaped, so NO wizard, glass staff, rat or hostage here. Secret door visually blends into wall. No readable Black Spider letter or castle reference, no revealed loot or invented ruined furniture.
